messages:
maria: dropping the near-final launch post draft in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/launch-apr. Please do legal + ops + product quick passes today.
evan: quick skim 1: hero looks good but we call out "~2.1x median latency improvement"  need the bench command and hardware to satisfy legal.
julie: product agrees with headline direction. prefer we frame cost line as 'in our tests' not 'up to' to avoid ambiguity. also want webinar CTA copy.
sam_legal: legal here. add bench harness, run count, seed, and a one-line footnote: "Internal benchmark performed 2026-04-01; results may vary." avoid words like 'guaranteed' or 'industry-leading'.
maria: added Methods snippet under appendix:
```
./run_bench --model rwd-13b-q4 --baseline open-13b --seq 128 --batch 8 --hw g5x --runs 180 --seed 3
```
results: median 48ms vs baseline 101ms (2.10x). run date: 2026-04-01.
evan: great. julie: CTA draft for webinar?
julie: CTA: "Join a live demo + benchmark walkthrough on May 6, 9am PT. Early-access seats limited; register: <link>". we'll demo throughput, cost breakdown, and Q&A.
harry_ops: routing notes: HubSpot form should include hidden fields `product_interest=redwood_inference` and `lead_source=launch_blog_apr`. First 72h: route to `launch-priority` queue, then to `launch-nurture`. Region mapping: NA->na-sales, EU->eu-sales, APAC->apac-sales. Also map `content_variant` -> hero_a/hero_b depending on CTA.
sam_legal: reviewing copy: with Methods and footnote that's ok. one request: add sentence under bench fig: "Results reflect internal configuration; workloads may vary."
maria: added the sentence and removed 'best-in-class' phrasing. updated hero subhead to: "Predictable, cost-effective LLM inference at scale" per product note.
evan: UTM for primary CTA please so analytics can map traffic.
harry_ops: use:
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=apr_launch&utm_content=demo_cta&lead_source=launch_blog_apr
```
include hs_prefix for HubSpot mapping.
maria: perfect. @publish-bot can you schedule publish Apr 10 10:00 PT and ensure embargo + press ping?
publish-bot: scheduled publish: 2026-04-10T17:00:00Z. embargo set. will notify #press and #social on release.
sam_legal: legal quick-pass 2705 with bench footnote and disclaimer.
julie: product 2705 on accuracy and CTA. harry_ops: routing 2705. maria: lock copy by EOD tomorrow so engineering can prep assets.
maria: locking by EOD tomorrow. final doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/launch-apr (locked for edits). Thanks team!"
